tasks.instruction: Uzupelnij ponizsze dialogi (1.1-1.6), wybierajac brakujace wyrazenie A, B lub C.

items.stem:
X: Don't say anything to Mum - the trip is meant to be a surprise.
Y: Relax, I won't let the ______ out of the bag.

X: Shall I start loading the car now?
Y: Hold your ______! We're not leaving until six.

X: How was your first day at the new school?
Y: Awful. I felt like a fish out of ______.

X: Did you find the shop in the end?
Y: No, it closed years ago. The whole trip was a wild ______ chase.

X: Piotr is still complaining about that one bad mark.
Y: Of course. He always makes a mountain out of a ______.

X: Do you think Adam will ever pay you back?
Y: When ______ fly.
